_comment: Win11Debloat configuration, tuned for a komorebi + yasb tiling desktop.
Passed to Win11Debloat.ps1 via -Config by scripts/debloat-windows.ps1.
Schema: {Version, Deployment:[{Name,Value}], Tweaks:[{Name,Value}]}, which is
what Scripts/Helpers/Import-ConfigToParams.ps1 reads. An earlier version of
this file used a single {Settings:[...]} list - the shape Win11Debloat's own
Config/DefaultSettings.json still has - and the importer ignored every entry
in it, then refused the file: 'The configuration file contains no importable
data.' Tweaks names must be FeatureIds from Config/Features.json; Deployment
understands only CreateRestorePoint, SkipRegistryBackup, RestartExplorer,
UserSelectionIndex, OtherUsername and AppRemovalScopeIndex.
Grouped by intent:
tiling   DisableWindowSnapping/SnapAssist/SnapLayouts stop Windows from
fighting komorebi for window placement. HideTabsInAltTab matters
because Alt+Tab is remapped to komorebic cycle-focus.
taskbar  yasb is the real bar, so this one is stripped to the minimum.
HideTaskview removes a button for a feature komorebi replaced.
explorer sane defaults: real extensions, hidden files, opens on This PC.
privacy  telemetry, Bing in search, suggestion surfaces, lockscreen ads.
ai       the built-in Copilot/Recall surfaces. Unrelated to the coding
agents this repo installs, which are not Windows features.
App removal is NOT here: it is opt-in behind -RemoveApps, and the list lives
in scripts/debloat-windows.ps1.
